answer: Sponsors are capped at 8 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 39 POA until the newcomer survives 14 clean epochs, and a farm of 500 fakes must find 500 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. A vertex that can be verified, a wander that can be measured, and a lantern that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
